title: K-Means Clustering Tutorial: Visualizing the Machine Learning Algorithm

cues.en: Instructor: Hello, and welcome back.
cues.zh: 講師：大家好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Today, we're talking about K-Means Clustering.
cues.zh: 今天要談 K-means 分群。

cues.en: This is going to be a fun tutorial, because K-Means is actually a very simple algorithm, and the best way to demonstrate it is visually.
cues.zh: 這會是一堂有趣的課，因為 K-means 其實是很簡單的演算法，最適合用視覺方式來示範。

cues.en: So here we have a scatter plot of our data points, and we want K-Means Clustering to create clusters.
cues.zh: 這裡有一張資料點的散布圖，我們要讓 K-means 分群建立群組。

cues.en: So we don't have any classes or categories in advance, we don't have any training data, we just have this data, and we want to create the clusters.
cues.zh: 事先沒有任何類別，也沒有訓練資料，只有這些資料，而我們想把它們分群。

cues.en: So how does it work?
cues.zh: 它如何運作呢？

cues.en: Well, the first thing is, well, first step is that you need to decide how many clusters you want.
cues.zh: 首先，第一步是決定你想要幾個群組。

cues.en: We'll talk about how to make this decision in next tutorial.
cues.zh: 下一堂會討論如何做這個決定。

cues.en: For now, let's say, we decided on two clusters.
cues.zh: 目前先假設我們決定分成兩群。

cues.en: Then, for each cluster, you need to place a randomly placed a centriod on this scatter plot, wherever you like, it doesn't have to be one of the existing points.
cues.zh: 接著為每個群組，在這張散布圖上隨機放置一個質心；位置可以任選，不一定要是既有的資料點。

cues.en: Now, what happens next is K-Means will assign each of the data points to the closest centroid.
cues.zh: 然後，K-means 會把每個資料點分配給離它最近的質心。

cues.en: In this case, it's easiest done by joining this equidistant line.
cues.zh: 在這個例子中，最容易的方式就是畫出這條等距線。

cues.en: Anything above is blue, is assigned to the blue centroid, anything below is assigned to the red centroid.
cues.zh: 線上方的點是藍色，分配給藍色質心；線下方的點分配給紅色質心。

cues.en: Now, the next step is quite interesting.
cues.zh: 下一步相當有趣。

cues.en: We need to calculate the centre of mass, or center of gravity for each of the clusters, the preliminary clusters that we've identified.
cues.zh: 我們要計算每個群組的質量中心，也就是重心；這些是剛才初步辨識出的群組。

cues.en: Of course, the centroid is not included in this calculation.
cues.zh: 當然，計算時不包含質心本身。

cues.en: So for example, for the blue cluster, we need to take all the X coordinates and take the average, and take all the Y coordinates, take the average.
cues.zh: 以藍色群組為例，要把所有 X 座標取平均，再把所有 Y 座標取平均。

cues.en: That'll give us the place, the position of the center of mass.
cues.zh: 這樣就能得到質量中心的位置。

cues.en: And then, we move the centroid to those positions.
cues.zh: 接著把質心移到這些位置。

cues.en: Once they've moved, we repeat the process, we reassign data points to the closest centroid.
cues.zh: 移動後重複這個流程，把資料點重新分配給最近的質心。

cues.en: So again, equidistant line, change the colors of the data points and assign.
cues.zh: 一樣畫出等距線，更改資料點的顏色並分配群組。

cues.en: And again, we calculate the center of gravity, center of mass, move the centroids, do the process again.
cues.zh: 再次計算重心，也就是質量中心，移動質心，再重複這個流程。

cues.en: Reassign, calculate the center of mass, move the centroids, do the process again.
cues.zh: 重新分配、計算質量中心、移動質心，再重複這個流程。

cues.en: Reassign, calculate the center of mass, move the centroids, do the process again.
cues.zh: 重新分配、計算質量中心、移動質心，再重複這個流程。

cues.en: And until we get into situation where doing the process again doesn't change anything, like in this state where we've drawn the equidistant line and already all the blue points are above
cues.zh: 直到再做一次也不會有任何改變，像現在這樣：畫出等距線後，所有藍點原本就都在線上方，

cues.en: and all the red points are below.
cues.zh: 而所有紅點都在線下方。

cues.en: And so that means we've come to the end of the K-Means Clustering step by step process.
cues.zh: 這代表 K-means 分群的逐步流程已經結束。

cues.en: And those are our final centroids.
cues.zh: 這些就是最終的質心。

cues.en: So that's how K-Means Clustering works.
cues.zh: 這就是 K-means 分群的運作方式。

cues.en: Very simple as you can see, but very effective as well.
cues.zh: 如你所見，非常簡單，也非常有效。

cues.en: And now, we have our two clusters and now we can go ahead and try to interpret what they mean from a business sense and from a domain knowledge sense.
cues.zh: 現在我們有了兩個群組，接著可以從商業與領域知識的角度，嘗試解讀它們的意義。

cues.en: I'll look forward to you next time.
cues.zh: 期待下次再見。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受機器學習的樂趣。
